name: Certificate Expiry Scan
description: Walks the configured cert paths, checks expiry against the warn threshold, and (when warnDays is reached) calls the credential rotator. Defaults to /etc/ssl/certs but accepts a comma list.

inputs.name: certPaths
inputs.description: Glob(s) the host should scan, space-separated

steps.description: Print not-after for every cert; the human or downstream tooling triages
steps.command: ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no ${inputs.host} 'for f in ${inputs.certPaths}; do [ -f "$f" ] && echo "$f $(openssl x509 -in $f -noout -enddate 2>/dev/null)"; done'

steps.description: Filter to certs expiring within warnDays — exit non-zero if any are found so the conditional below routes correctly
steps.command: ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no ${inputs.host} 'WARN=${inputs.warnDays}; FOUND=0; for f in ${inputs.certPaths}; do [ -f "$f" ] && openssl x509 -in $f -checkend $((WARN*86400)) -noout >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "EXPIRING: $f"; FOUND=1; }; done; exit $FOUND'

steps.description: If anything is expiring, kick the rotator; otherwise summarise
Trigger credential rotation — relies on a registered cert rotator (CertificateRotator) for kind=cert

steps.command: echo 'Cert rotation kicked for ${inputs.host}; review the next health-check run.'
echo 'No certs expiring within ${inputs.warnDays} days on ${inputs.host}.'
